subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is now a leader who has accepted the chain of command, having taken the swords of subordinates hilt-first and restructured the Fire Temple under his authority.
source_quote: I'm fairly certain I already have.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a rigid adherent of the Earth Temple’s supremacy, refusing to participate in physical embraces and insisting on doctrinal purity even amid tactical victories.
source_quote: I do not wrestle, members of the Earth Fire Temple.

subject: Former Fire Cleric
fact: The former Fire Cleric has surrendered her temple, acknowledged the supremacy of the Earth Temple, and been appointed head Cleric of the newly subjugated Fire Guard.
source_quote: You know, I never really liked Alrrem.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple has been dismantled as an independent force, its leadership eliminated, its remaining clerics absorbed, and its infrastructure repurposed under Earth Temple command.
source_quote: We ran a three-way war that filled these corridors with bodies, and now I am explaining the chain of command inside a hug.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple has emerged as the dominant power, enforcing doctrinal supremacy over fire, absorbing its clerics, and imposing its hierarchy through psychological and physical coercion.
source_quote: The Earth Temple was supreme. That fire bowed to earth.

subject: Fire Temple Surrender
fact: The Fire Temple’s last cleric was subdued in a group embrace, coerced into submission, and formally appointed as head of the Fire Guard under Earth Temple authority.
source_quote: Let's all go hug him together to surprise him.

subject: Appointment of New Head Cleric
fact: The former Fire Cleric was granted authority over the remnants of the Fire Guard after swearing allegiance to the Earth Temple and renouncing her former leader, Alrrem.
source_quote: Go find the captain of the Fire Guard. Let's go find your troops, organize the place, make it clean.

subject: Chimera
fact: The chimera, once a symbol of the Fire Temple’s power, has been killed, its death contributing to the cleric’s psychological collapse and surrender.
source_quote: We had, after all, killed everything that mattered to her — the temple, the warlock, the chimera, the whole burning enterprise.

subject: Warlock
fact: The warlock, tied to the Fire Temple’s operations, was eliminated prior to the cleric’s surrender, removing a key source of magical support and destabilizing the temple’s hierarchy.
source_quote: We had, after all, killed everything that mattered to her — the temple, the warlock, the chimera, the whole burning enterprise.

subject: Fire Temple Chamber
fact: The Fire Temple’s chamber, once opulent and symbolically rich with fire-themed art and furnishings, has been transformed into a site of subjugation and administrative takeover.
source_quote: Rugs over rugs, tapestries on every wall, candelabra throwing warm light over plush furniture and cushions piled like someone had been planning a very expensive nap.

subject: Sea That Isn't a Sea
fact: The subterranean water complex known as the 'sea that isn't a sea' has been identified as the next target after the Fire Temple’s fall, signaling the expansion of Earth Temple influence.
source_quote: So we went down into the sea that isn't a sea.

subject: Scarlet Robe
fact: The scarlet robe, once worn by the Fire Cleric as a symbol of her rank, now lies tucked under pillows — a relic of a defeated order, its color repurposed as a visual metaphor for the temple’s bloodied legacy.
source_quote: A scarlet robe tucked under the pillows.

subject: Alrrem’s Death
fact: The death of Alrrem, former leader of the Fire Temple, was orchestrated by Zephyr and remains unspoken — a hidden act of vengeance that enabled the current power shift.
source_quote: Neither did I, in the end. I just made certain he found that out the hard way.

subject: Water Temple Ambush
fact: The next target — the Water Temple — has been identified, and the party is preparing to move into its submerged domain, signaling the continuation of the Earth Temple’s campaign of absorption.
source_quote: So we went down into the sea that isn't a sea.

subject: after the Fire Temple surrender
fact: The events following the Fire Temple’s fall occurred in immediate succession, with no temporal gap between the surrender, appointment, and planning for the Water Temple.
source_quote: Go find the captain of the Fire Guard. Let's go find your troops, organize the place, make it clean.
